question:
By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

+ and ×, 1 and 2
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

According to the question**, **after interchanging the given two signs and numbers :

 
• + and ×
 
• 1 and 2

So,

__
 
• Option - (1) : 8 × 3 – 4 ÷ 2 + 1 = 7

​​After interchanging:

8 + 3 – **4 ÷ 1**__ × 2 = 7

8 + 3 – **__4__**__** × 2**__ = 7

__**8 + 3**__ - 8 = 7
